field-md.$description: Field height, size md — the system's field (readme §3.10).

field-select-min.$description: A Select's intrinsic minimum width (R90, R95): its native select overlays the box, so a content-sized parent would otherwise shrink it to the chevron and clip the placeholder. 128px = a short placeholder plus the chrome, and still fits a two-up row at the 360px floor (~158px a column).

field-spinner.$description: The pulsing mark while a field validates.

field-suffix.$description: A field's trailing unit or count, set in Space Mono.

field-ring-danger.$description: Focus ring of a field in error.

field-ring-success.$description: Focus ring of a field in success.

field-ring-warning.$description: Focus ring of a field in warning.
